title: AudioPlaybackEvent
description: M12A § Audio event surface — one playback dispatch from cf-audio. Mirrors cf_audio::deterministic_replay::AudioPlaybackEvent and the cf-replay audio.event_played event payload. The event is always cosmetic per M12A spec § Replay parity contract (cosmetic=true means the event does NOT enter the determinism checksum, but MUST fire in deterministic order per tick).

tick.description: Sim tick at which the event fires.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-tick sequence number used to break ties between cues firing on the same tick.

canonical_name.description: Canonical name from the cf-asset-ledger (e.g. sfx_pistol_fire).

gain.description: Pre-computed effective gain (distance × occlusion × bus volume).

cosmetic.description: Always true for audio events per M12A § Replay parity.
